item.title: Protests against Khamenei’s killing: Curbs remain in force in Kashmir

item.title: ATS conducts late-night raids in Mumbai over Pak terror links; 4 suspects questioned
item.description: MUMBAI: In a late-night crackdown, the Maharashtra Anti-Terrorism Squad (ATS) raided four locations in the suburbs of Mumbai over suspected links to a Pakistan-based terror outfit, an official said on Tuesday. item.title: Prominent temples in UP closed during lunar eclipse
item.description: LUCKNOW: Prominent temples across Uttar Pradesh, including the Ram temple in Ayodhya, Kashi Vishwanath temple in Varanasi, Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi temple and the Vindhyavasini temple in Mirzapur, were closed on Tuesday in view of the lunar eclipse and will reopen in the evening after rituals.
